## Downtime

`startedAt`, `endedAt` (empty = ongoing), `planned`, `reason`. Computed `hours`, `isOpen`. Availability = 1 − Σ downtime ÷ period, in `utils/maintenance.ts` (`availability`) so the asset, the Home hero and any report agree.

Generic: a compressor, a server, a meeting room, a vehicle.

A planned window (a scheduled shutdown) still counts against availability; `planned` lets a report separate it from a breakdown.

cardInfo.name: Downtime
cardInfo.summary: An interval something was unavailable — planned or unplanned, open-ended while running; feeds availability.
